name: Agent Reach
tagline: A tool that lets your AI assistant read Twitter, Reddit, YouTube and other sites it normally can't see.
sentence: Give your AI coding tool one command and it can search Bilibili, read Reddit threads, pull YouTube transcripts and browse 10+ platforms - no API keys or paid subscriptions needed for most channels.

board.say: AI assistants can't browse the real internet - they can't read Twitter threads, Reddit posts, YouTube transcripts or Chinese platforms like Bilibili.
You ask your AI assistant to look something up on a specific platform - for example, 'search Twitter for reactions to the new iPhone.'
A search query or a URL from a supported platform (Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, GitHub, and others).
It connects to the platform, fetches the content and returns it in a format the AI can read.
steps: Picks the right channel for the platform (Bilibili, YouTube, Reddit, etc.) or detects it from the URL
Fetches the page content - search results, video transcripts, thread comments, or profile data
Returns structured text the AI assistant can read and act on

board.say: Real internet content your AI assistant can read, summarize and act on.

outputs.eg: A Bilibili search for a topic returns video titles, view counts and descriptions
A YouTube video URL returns the full transcript (speech-to-text if no subtitles exist, using a Groq key)
A Reddit URL returns the post text and top comments in plain text

before: Your AI assistant is blind to the live internet - it can't read social media, watch videos or check what people are saying right now
Getting content from platforms like Bilibili or XiaoHongShu requires building custom scrapers or paying for API access
Each platform has its own format - there's no single tool that reads them all
after: One command (`agent-reach read <url>`) fetches content from 10+ platforms and returns it as plain text
Most channels work without API keys - YouTube speech-to-text and podcast transcription need a free Groq key
Your AI assistant can now research across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, GitHub, V2EX and more
uses_note: Agent Reach has 106K stars and is widely referenced in Chinese AI agent tutorials, but specific named uses with results are thin in English-language coverage.

coverage.title: Agent Reach: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet
How to use Agent Reach with AI coding tools

steps: Ask your AI assistant to install Agent Reach by giving it the [install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/main/docs/install.md) - it handles the setup itself
Try a basic search: ask your assistant to run `agent-reach bilibili search` with a topic, or `agent-reach read <url>` with any supported URL
To add optional platforms (XiaoHongShu, LinkedIn, Reddit): ask your assistant to run `agent-reach` and follow the prompts to add channels
try.paste:
/skillspector https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach
Then: Follow the install guide and test with 'agent-reach channels' to see available platforms, then try 'agent-reach read' with a URL.

footprint.runs_on: Python 3.10 or newer. Uses `uv` as its package manager (installed automatically). Works on Mac, Windows and Linux. Some platforms need logins stored in ~/.agent-reach/.

best_for: Anyone who wants their AI assistant to research topics across social media and video platforms
People who work with Chinese platforms like Bilibili and XiaoHongShu
AI agent builders who need live internet data without paying for API access
skip_if: You need guaranteed reliability - scraping can break when platforms change their pages
You only need web search - a simpler tool like Jina Reader covers basic web pages
You're concerned about terms of service - scraping social media may violate platform rules

alternatives.name: Jina Reader
alternatives.line: Reads any web page as clean text - simpler but doesn't handle platform-specific features like video transcripts

alternatives.name: Exa
alternatives.line: AI-native search engine with an API - more reliable but requires an API key and has usage limits

watch: **Scraping can break.** Platforms change their pages regularly, and channels that work today may stop working tomorrow. The README labels Twitter, Facebook and Instagram as 'experimental.'
**Don't install the PyPI package.** The README warns that a package named `agent-reach` on PyPI is not this project. Install only from the GitHub repo.
**No official cryptocurrency.** The README includes a warning that crypto projects using the Agent Reach name are unrelated scams. Don't connect a wallet or pay fees.
**Some channels need logins.** Bilibili subtitles, XiaoHongShu and LinkedIn require logging in. Login credentials are stored locally in ~/.agent-reach/.
